fusions.name: Bloom of Barbs
fusions.desc: Fires a stinging cell that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 2 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Spawning Night
fusions.desc: A burst of stored venom that deals 28 poison damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and is always a critical hit. Each target is left [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Crevice Lurker
fusions.desc: Raises a reef head where you stand for 14 seconds. A sea krait strikes from its crevices at an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Krait's Crossing
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
